summary.oneLiner: Manufacturer, distributor and marketer of polyurethane (PU) foam, mattresses and other home comfort products for Indian consumers.
summary.business: Sham Foam Limited is a vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane (PU) foam, mattresses, pillows, cushions and other home comfort products, sold under the Featherfresh and Restivia brands. It also manufactures industrial-grade PU Foam used in furniture, sports products, seat covers, shoes, innerwear, jackets and related apparel, distributed through a pan-India dealer network.

currentContext.expansion: No new plant is being added; Net Proceeds are earmarked for civil construction and purchase of machinery/equipment at the EXISTING Ambala (Haryana) manufacturing facility to expand/upgrade capacity, alongside working-capital funding.
